This Microsoft component is not licensed under this project's MIT license. Microsoft terms apply.
Official information: https://learn.microsoft.com/windows-hardware/get-started/adk-install
The bootstrapper may download additional Microsoft payloads. Only Deployment Tools is requested.
Hash and Microsoft Authenticode are checked before execution. Shared ADK components are not removed by WinImageStudio's uninstaller.
Installer engine: Inno Setup, https://jrsoftware.org/isinfo.php. Installer engines are subject to the Inno Setup license; the compiler's license is included in the build output notices.
